title: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Debiasing and Detoxification in Multilingual LLMs: An Extensive Investigation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmarks measured stereotypical bias related to religion. Specifically, CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet measure stereotypes by comparing model probabilities for stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentences. The BiasDPO dataset was used for finetuning to mitigate religion biases.
findings: Finetuning on the Panda dataset, which does not include religion bias, did not mitigate religion bias in most languages, with small exceptions in English and Spanish. Finetuning on the BiasDPO dataset, which does include religion as a category, was not able to substantially mitigate religion bias as evaluated on the StereoSet benchmark.
